reviewer: Same assistant as executor; fresh scoped semantic pass after checkpoint correction; not an independent model or human acceptance
parts: A/B/C/D/E/F/H proportionate execution checkpoint; no implementation/release transition

counterexamples.case: Positive clock reaction silently becomes keep/voice/publish approval
counterexamples.disposition: Rejected: preference/note only; active voice examples remain empty; publisher flag false.

counterexamples.case: Transfer adds another independent first-six subject or resets old8-call history
counterexamples.disposition: Rejected: existing calibration group/parent retained, new explicitly admitted Q6 package; no new genuine subject or eligible first-six count.

counterexamples.case: Same AI umbrella makes the concept a repeated black-box variant
counterexamples.disposition: Distinct protected question and evidence: full-work effort/usable completion versus explanation/reliability; no claim of independent subject count or human success.

counterexamples.case: Model essentials or saved visual-plan JSON substitute for human quality/rendered output
counterexamples.disposition: Rejected: machine transfer only; all human/corpus and R8 gates remain open.

counterexamples.case: Restart/read causes a new model effect or changes original output
counterexamples.disposition: Actual repeat/conflict/export added0calls; all attempt bytes retained.

counterexamples.case: Current metadata falsely makes an earlier source review certify new checkpoint
counterexamples.disposition: Old FINAL_REVIEW remains historical for code/earlier pair; this explicit same-assistant review binds current pair; no new independent-review claim.

human_required: Graham review of saved parcel text, factual/voice/construction/usefulness/visual value and actual effort when supplied; separate explicit example approval if desired.
RESUME_AT: Record actual parcel disposition; continue next admitted dependent plan step. Do not regenerate completed work or start filler trials.
invalidation: Changed current pair or product/source/budget bindings
